name: Lung Ming Green Energy Technology Engineering Co., Ltd.
summary: Lung Ming Green Energy Technology Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the electromechanical system integration and construction engineering, and waste disposal business for technology plants, industrial plants, and residential buildings. The company offers high-tech clean room electromechanical systems; electromechanical systems for industrial plants; general building electromechanical systems for apartment buildings and public facilities; and civil engineering and construction services.
